we propose a novel approach to approximate tensor operations for neural network training, which provides the same convergence guarantees as SGD, and that we introduce new sampling techniques that can be used for approximate matrix multiplication and convolution.

(i) our proposed sampling technique for matrix multiplication provides the same convergence guarantee as the original algorithm, but with faster training speed, (ii) our proposed sampling algorithm for matrix multiplication is the first to provide a convergence guarantee in a non-asymptotic setting, and (iii) our proposed sampling techniques for convolution provide the same convergence guarantee when applied to SGD, but with faster convergence speed.
